description: Economic at-rest protection for models/packs. User case vaults are separate (SQLCipher + passphrase) and never ransomed by this layer.

algorithm.key_derivation: SHA-256 over machine fingerprint components + protection salt
algorithm.integrity: SHA-256 of ciphertext per asset + manifest seal
